relationship.statement: A simple pendulum's swing period increases with the square root of its length, while bob mass and small release angles leave the timing unchanged.
assumptions: Small release angles (up to 25 degrees) keep the motion nearly simple harmonic.
Air resistance and rod mass are neglected, and gravity stays fixed at 9.81 m/s2.
The reference pendulum is fixed at 1.0 m length, 1.0 kg mass, and 15 degrees.

math.code: function compute(inputs, t) { var g = 9.81; var refL = 1.0; var refA0Deg = 15; var refPivotX = -1.1; var testPivotX = 1.1; var pivotY = 2.6; var L = inputs.length; var m = inputs.mass; var a0Deg = inputs.angle0; var omegaTest = Math.sqrt(g / L); var omegaRef = Math.sqrt(g / refL); var testPeriod = 2 * Math.PI / omegaTest; var refPeriod = 2 * Math.PI / omegaRef; var a0Rad = a0Deg * Math.PI / 180; var refA0Rad = refA0Deg * Math.PI / 180; var thetaTest = a0Rad * Math.cos(omegaTest * t); var thetaRef = refA0Rad * Math.cos(omegaRef * t); var testAngle = thetaTest * 180 / Math.PI; var refAngle = thetaRef * 180 / Math.PI; var testSpeed = Math.abs(-L * a0Rad * omegaTest * Math.sin(omegaTest * t)); var testX = testPivotX + L * Math.sin(thetaTest); var testY = pivotY - L * Math.cos(thetaTest); var refX = refPivotX + refL * Math.sin(thetaRef); var refY = pivotY - refL * Math.cos(thetaRef); var testBobSize = 0.2 + 0.15 * m; var refBobSize = 0.35; var sameLen = Math.abs(L - refL) < 0.01; var diffOther = Math.abs(m - 1.0) > 0.01 || Math.abs(a0Deg - refA0Deg) > 0.01; return { testPeriod: testPeriod, refPeriod: refPeriod, testAngle: testAngle, refAngle: refAngle, testSpeed: testSpeed, testX: testX, testY: testY, refX: refX, refY: refY, testBobSize: testBobSize, refBobSize: refBobSize, isSameLength: sameLen && !diffOther, isSameLengthDiffOther: sameLen && diffOther, isLonger: L > refL + 0.01 }; }

lesson.title: What changes a pendulum swing?
lesson.description: Compare a test pendulum against a fixed 1 m reference by changing its length, mass, and release angle. Watch both bobs swing and track their angles over time.
lesson.instructions: Adjust Length, Mass, and Release angle, then press play or scrub time. Set Length to 1.0 m and vary Mass or Release angle to test whether they change the swing period.
lesson.goal: Only length changes a simple pendulum's period at fixed gravity; mass and small release angles change bob size or swing width without changing the timing.
